name: Template studio generates a reveal.js deck from scratch without a template
description: The 'From scratch' mode with the reveal.js engine generates a standalone HTML deck and opens it in the viewer with working keyboard navigation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL / and click the 'Template studio — HTML decks' mode switch tab.
Find and enable the 'From scratch' mode toggle in the Template studio panel.
If an engine choice is offered, pick the reveal.js engine option.
In the Brief textarea type: 'Introduction to Kubernetes for backend engineers: pods, services, deployments and rolling updates'.
Click the generate button (its label mentions generating a reveal.js deck, like 'Generate reveal.js deck').
Verify a progress indicator appears while the deck is generated.

Within 180 seconds verify the deck viewer opens with the generated deck: a slide counter, navigation controls and visible slide content with styled formatting (dark or themed background is common for reveal decks).
Press the ArrowRight key to advance a slide.
Verify the slide counter advances and a new slide is displayed.
